messages.subject: Error when specifying parameter file
parts:
Greetings! 

I am having an odd error when using MIRT with anchor items. I am trying to set the parameters for three items (out of 8) based on a larger calibration sample. I have done this before without any issues but I am now seeing a strange error. 

"Error: Rows in supplied and starting value data.frame objects do not match. Were the data or itemtype input arguments modified?"

Originally I was creating a parameter file and modifying value and setting estimate to be false:

    parameter_setup <- mirt(catagorical_data, 1, "nominal", pars = "values")

Then, once modification was done I tried to run the model with:

    mirt(catagorical_data, 1, pars = parameter_setup)

That was when I encountered the error. Now the strange thing is if I don't modify anything at all I still get the error. Essentially, I am just generating the pars file and then trying to use it without modification and it still isn't working. 


Versions:
OS: Ubuntu 18.04 x64
MIRT: 1.29
R: 3.4.4

messages.subject: Re: Error when specifying parameter file
parts:
Hi 

I got a similar error when I try to score graded response with "grsm" itemtype.

Each item has 7 categories. I clarified itemtype in all mirt functions as

#### parameter estimation
mod_crv<-mirt(crv16,1,itemtype = "grsm")
coef.mod_crv <- coef(mod_crv,simplify=TRUE)$items
## fixing parameters
sv <- mirt(crv16,1, itemtype = "grsm",pars = "values")
sv$value[sv$name=="a1"]<-coef.mod_crv[,1]
sv$value[sv$name=="d1"]<-coef.mod_crv[,2]
sv$value[sv$name=="d2"]<-coef.mod_crv[,3]
sv$value[sv$name=="d3"]<-coef.mod_crv[,4]
sv$value[sv$name=="d4"]<-coef.mod_crv[,5]
sv$value[sv$name=="d5"]<-coef.mod_crv[,6]
sv$value[sv$name=="d6"]<-coef.mod_crv[,7]
sv$value[sv$name=="c"] <-coef.mod_crv[,8]
sv$est <- FALSE
#### scoring 
fit_crv19<-mirt(crv19,1,itemtype = "grsm",pars = sv)

Then I got an error:
Error: Constraint applied to fixed parameter(s) 2 3 4 5 6 7 10 11 12 13 14 15 18 19 20 21 22 23 26 27 28 29 30 31 34 35 36 37 38 39 42 43 44 45 46 47 50 51 52 53 54 55 58 59 60 61 62 63 66 67 68 69 70 71 74 75 76 77 78 79 82 83 84 85 86 87 90 91 92 93 94 95 98 99 100 101 102 103 106 107 108 109 110 111 114 115 116 117 118 119  but should only be applied to estimated parameters. Please fix!

How can I fix the d values in the scoring step in this case?

Thanks a lot!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Error when specifying parameter file
parts:
Passing mirt(..., technical = list(internal_constraints = FALSE)) will remove all of the automatically generated internal constraints that mirt uses to estimate these models. That should fix your issue as the equality constraints will no longer be applied to fixed parameters since they won't be implied at all.

Phil
